admissions.threshold: Biology (Faculty of Science, Biological, Biomedical & Life Sciences group): IB Diploma with Maths and two of Biology, Chemistry or Physics (at least one maths/science at HL; SL Maths AI not accepted); typical range 36 to 39 subject points out of 42. Guideline ranges only; admission is competitive.

Biology (Faculty of Science, Biological, Biomedical & Life Sciences group): three A-Levels including Maths and at least one of Biology, Chemistry or Physics, with Biology, Chemistry, Maths and Physics at GCSE; typical range A*AA to AAB. Guideline ranges only; admission is competitive.

Biology (Faculty of Science, Biological, Biomedical & Life Sciences group): pre-calculus and two of biology, chemistry or physics; typically B+ to A- average in grades 11 and 12 with A- in each prerequisite maths and science; SAT/ACT typical ACT 29-31 or SAT Reading & Writing 690-700, Math 690-710. Guideline ranges only; admission is competitive.
